annotation.authors_or_issuer: Court of Justice of the European Union (Directorate-General for Information)
key_provisions_or_claims: Creates an AI Management Board to apply a risk-based approach and define 'red lines' where AI must not be used
Six principles: fairness/non-discrimination, transparency, traceability, privacy and data protection, human oversight, continuous improvement
Judicial AI to run on-premises to protect sensitive data; training and run environments separated
Governance via existing boards, AI+ Network, Data Governance Board and Innovation Lab
Upskilling through the Emerging Technologies Academy and a mobility board; AI capabilities map for reuse
annotation.summary_en: Internal AI strategy of the Court of Justice of the European Union, approved June 2023. It sets a vision, goals, principles, risk mitigations and a governance model built around an AI Management Board with risk-based 'red lines', on-premises handling of judicial data, workforce upskilling and a reusable AI capabilities architecture.
annotation.title_clean: Artificial Intelligence Strategy of the Court of Justice of the European Union
